newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA TO HOST WORLD FISCAL EXPERTS' CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: INDIA TO HOST WORLD FISCAL EXPERTS' CONFERENCE.

text.p: The 51st congress of the International Fiscal Association (IFA) will be held for the first time in Asia at New Delhi between October 19 and 24, IFA's Indian unit said on Friday.
The IFA said in a statement that about 1,200 delegates from over 50 countries had registered to participate in the congress.
"The delegates comprise tax specialists, chartered accountants, fiscal policy makers, researchers and administrators as well as corporate tax managers," it said.
